name: Blenheim Golf Club
description: A pleasant parkland course in the heart of Marlborough wine country near Blenheim. The flat, well-maintained layout is ideal for a relaxed round, with vineyards and the Richmond Range providing an attractive backdrop.

name: Picton Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course near the Marlborough Sounds ferry terminal in Picton. Its convenient location makes it an ideal round for golfers arriving or departing on the Interislander, with views across the harbour and surrounding hills.

name: Renwick Golf Club
description: A small, friendly rural course in the wine village of Renwick, surrounded by Marlborough vineyards. The relaxed atmosphere and easy-walking layout make it perfect for a casual round between cellar door visits.

name: Havelock Golf Club
description: A tiny rural 9-hole in Havelock, known as the mussel capital of New Zealand. The intimate course sits in a scenic setting at the gateway to the Marlborough Sounds, offering a charming and unhurried golfing experience.
